Frequently Asked Questions

Everything You Need to Know

How long does it take to see results from social media marketing?+
Most clients see measurable improvements in engagement and reach within 30–60 days. Significant lead generation and ROI results typically appear within 3–6 months of consistent strategy execution.
Which social media platforms should my business focus on?+
It depends on your target audience. B2B businesses benefit most from LinkedIn, while B2C brands typically see strong results on Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube. We help you identify the right mix.
How do you measure the success of social media campaigns?+
We track KPIs including reach, engagement rate, follower growth, click-through rate, lead generation, and ROI. You receive detailed monthly reports with actionable insights.
Do you run paid ads on social media?+
Yes. We manage paid social campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Twitter — optimised for your goals whether that's brand awareness, leads, or direct sales.
